text.en:
There is hereby created a Division of Investigation under the Commissioner of Civil Service for
the purpose of carrying into effect the provisions of Executive Order Numbered Thirty-nine, promulgated by
the President of the Philippines, on the twenty-third day of June, nineteen hundred and thirty-six.

To carry out the purposes of this Act and subject to the provisions of the Civil Service Law, the
following sums, or so much thereof as may be respectively necessary, are hereby appropriated out of any
funds in the Philippine Treasury not appropriated for other purposes, for the fiscal year ending December
thirty-first, nineteen hundred and thirty-seven.
SALARIES AND WAGES
One chief of division
One assistant chief of division
3,000.00
One attorney
2,400.00
1,680.00
720.00
480.00
420.00
One messenger
300.00
OTHER EXPENSES

Sundry expenses and purchase of furniture and equipment
Grand total
